column1: # Das Reich\PG2_readme.txt · 译文填写表：只改第三列（译文），其余别动

column3: 帝国师(Das Reich) 1939-1945 第 2 版战役。

column2: This version 2 of the campaign is the result incorporating challenge campaign player's comments and retooling version 1 for the PGUK202 patch.
column3: 本战役的第 2 版是吸收了挑战战役玩家意见、并为 PGUK202 补丁重新调整第 1 版之后的结果。

column2: The first campaign I made was Langemarck which is a special mission / limited deployment campaign. What Das Reich is concerned, expect a Blitzkrieg type campaign.
column3: 我做的第一个战役是 Langemarck，那是一个特殊任务 / 有限部署战役。至于 Das Reich，请期待一个闪击战类型的战役。

column2: I would like to thank Pat, Raymond, Adler, Helmic, Doug and those people I cannot remember now for all their hours of playtesting and Rick for reviewing and correcting the briefing text files. A big thank you goes out to the Challenge Campaign 16 players for their very constructive feedback and Adler for his e-file.
column3: 我要感谢 Pat、Raymond、Adler、Helmic、Doug 以及那些我现在记不起来的人，感谢他们投入的大量试玩时间，也感谢 Rick 审阅并修正简报文本文件。还要衷心感谢挑战战役 16 的玩家们提出了非常有建设性的反馈，以及 Adler 提供了他的装备文件。

column2: E-FILE: The campaign can be played using the included e-file or Adler 4000 file version beta019D or later. The included e-file is a 'equipment availability' modified Adler 019D file that makes play more historical for an SS division.
column3: 装备文件：可以用随附的装备文件，或者 Adler 4000 文件的 beta019D 版或更高版本游玩本战役。随附的装备文件是修改过"装备可用性"的 Adler 019D 文件，能让游玩过程更符合一个党卫军师的历史情况。

column2: MAPS: The following non-SSI maps are required:
column3: 地图：需要以下非 SSI 地图：

column2: SHolland, UlmNorth, Dieppe, Belgrade, Kazan, Yelnya, Laon, Konotop, Romny, Borodino, Istra, Don, Toulon, Kharkov2, Prok2, Prok, Laon, Avranchesat, Sedan40, Bastogne, Kitilae and Berlin\t.
SMACK VIDEO FILES: The following (optional) non-PG2 video files are used:
column3: SMACK 视频文件：使用了以下（可选）非 PG2 视频文件：

column2: FAS5, FAS6, FAS9, FAS10, FAS11, FAS12, FAS13, FAS14, FAS15, FAS16, 001, 003, 005, 007, 008, 010, 012, 013, 014, 017, 018, 020, 021, 023, 024, 027, 034, 035, 037, 086 and Kursk. These files can be downloaded from http://www.adlerkorps.com/
SOUND FILES: Download the Panzer General I sounds from  http://www.adlerkorps.com/ and unzip in the sound directory.
column3: 声音文件：从  http://www.adlerkorps.com/ 下载 Panzer General I 的声音，并解压到 sound 目录。

column2: INSTALLATION: Instructions for dummies to upgrade your PG2 to run this campaign can be found at http://www.wargamer.com/pg2campaigns/steve/pg2.htm in the Clearinghouse section.
column3: 安装：把 PG2 升级到能运行本战役的傻瓜式说明，可以在 http://www.wargamer.com/pg2campaigns/steve/pg2.htm 的 Clearinghouse 版块找到。
